text_block_list.text:
Amid wild excitement, the curtain closes
on the
Takarazuka Kinen, where Air
Groove has
managed to snatch victory
from Сайленс Судзука.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
However, Эйр Грув is dazzled by
Suzuka's
magnificent running, which sets
her fans ablaze
with unparallelled
excitement.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Worrying that she can't compare, Air
Groove
finds herself in fear of Silence
Suzuka.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her heart bruised and her composure
rattled, Air
Groove puts on a brave face
to focus on the
Sapporo Kinen ahead,
but nonetheless leaves the
racecourse
dejected.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
